RunSynchronousCommand.Description: Extrair os scripts embutidos neste XML para X:\mywiniso
RunSynchronousCommand.Path: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p = (Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKLM\System\Setup' -Name 'UnattendFile' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).UnattendFile; if (-not $p -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { $p = @('X:\Unattend.xml', 'X:\autounattend.xml') + @([char[]](65..90) | ForEach-Object { [string]$_ + ':\autounattend.xml' }) | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath $_ } | Select-Object -First 1 }; $x = [xml]::new(); $x.Load($p); Invoke-Command -ScriptBlock ([scriptblock]::Create($x.GetElementsByTagName('ExtractScript')[0].InnerText)) -ArgumentList $x, 'windowsPE'"

SynchronousCommand.Description: Login automático permanente e setup.ps1 do repositório

Extensions.File:
# Roda uma vez, no primeiro logon do alexandre, elevado. # 1. deixa o login automático permanente (o do autounattend vale para um logon só) # 2. cria mywiniso-setup.cmd na área de trabalho, para rodar o setup de novo quando quiser # 3. baixa o setup.ps1 do repositório e roda: é ele que instala os programas
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue' [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12 Start-Transcript -Path (Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'mywiniso.log') -Append | Out-Null
$raw = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eualexandrerrr/mywiniso/main'
$wl = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon' Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $wl -Name 'AutoAdminLogon' -Value '1' -Type String Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $wl -Name 'DefaultUserName' -Value $env:USERNAME -Type String Set-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $wl -Name 'DefaultPassword' -Value '' -Type String Remove-ItemProperty -LiteralPath $wl -Name 'AutoLogonCount' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$desktop = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('Desktop') $cmd = "@echo off`r`npowershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command `"irm $raw/setup.ps1 | iex`"`r`npause`r`n" [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $desktop 'mywiniso-setup.cmd'), $cmd, [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
$destino = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mywiniso-setup.ps1' $ok = $false for ($i = 0; $i -lt 60 -and -not $ok; $i++) { # até 5 minutos esperando a rede try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "$raw/setup.ps1" -OutFile $destino -TimeoutSec 15 $ok = $true } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 5 } } if (-not $ok) { Write-Warning "Sem internet: não baixei o setup.ps1. Quando tiver rede, rode mywiniso-setup.cmd na área de trabalho." Stop-Transcript | Out-Null exit 0 }
powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $destino Stop-Transcript | Out-Null exit 0
